mt: THE FORTNIGHT TO 3 NOVEMBER ON THE OVERVIEW — A TABLE OF #1708–#1727 WITH THE TITLES, SERIES AND DATES RIGHT, AN AXN MISPAIRED, AND THE WINDOW STOPPING AT NOVEMBER 1: NOVEMBER 2 AND 3 NOT REACHED; NO PERSON NAMED
d: THE FORTNIGHT, SIGNED OUT, THE OVERVIEW EXPANDED, 2026-11-03: the archive as 'a deeply cohesive, self-reflexive body of thought' treating model collapse, loss of provenance and semantic capitalism 'as an ontological war'; three 'concurrent conceptual lines' between October 27 and November 1; a table of six rows (#1727, #1726, #1724, #1722, #1714, #1708–1713); a 'Reading Framework' under the heading 'Sappho Future Reader & SPXI Poetics'; 'a unified digital immune system'. Five source cards, all alexanarch.org.
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked for the last two weeks as a living body of thought, the Overview reads the browse page and the homepage, tabulates six of the fortnight's deposits with titles, identifiers and dates, groups them into three lines, and gives a summary in which the archive answers extraction with seatings and instruments.
findings: THE TABLE ON THE RECORDS, ONE IDENTIFIER WRONG. The six rows carry real numbers, titles, series and dates: #1727 (Nov 1) 'EA-SOPHISTRY-01 v1.0', #1726 (Oct 31) 'EA-NEGONT-02 v0.10' with its 'First Traversal of Howl' and Theophrastus examples (the record's title: 'Worked Examples on Model Collapse, Theophrastus and SPXI and a First Traversal of Howl'), #1724 (Oct 31) 'EA-MPAI-SEMANTIC-WARFARE-01 v1.1', #1714 (Oct 27) 'EA-SEM-FEUDALISM-03 v1.0' on 'OpenAI’s late-2026 mathematics and science releases' (the record: 'in OpenAI's Mathematics and Science Releases, October 2026'), #1708–1713 as 'EA-CORPORA-25 through 28' with Spinoza, Leibniz, Nietzsche, Du Bois and the declared absences of Deleuze, Guattari and Hypatia (#1712, #1710, #1713). #1722 is given '(AXN:0A9F)', which is #1716's AXN; #1722's is AXN:0B2A.

THE WINDOW STOPS AT NOVEMBER 1. 'Between October 27 and November 1, 2026' and 'The late October 2026 output' frame a fortnight asked to run 'through 3 Nov'; #1728–#1735 (Ils ne sont pas marxistes, the Thirty-First and Thirty-Second Seatings, Legitimately Many, its packet, Revelation First) are not reached. The browse card reads 'Browse — Alexanarch (1732 deposits)': the index the Overview read held the archive to #1732, and the composition reached its first card's top row.

PHRASES WITH NO LOCUS. 'moral correction', set in quotation marks as what 'Alexanarch frames', is absent from #1726 and occurs in two older records only; 'The Author as "Such As"' and 'a poetics of constrained variation' for SPXI are in no seated text. The heading 'Sappho Future Reader' joins a Capture Registry semantic address ('develop a reading of spxi protocol as a writing p...', the second card) with the archive's Sappho line.

THE CAPTURE REGISTRY AS THE ARCHIVE'S METHOD. 'if an external AI model misinterprets or flattens a text, that false framing is absorbed by the archive, assigned an AXN identifier, and used to generate a deeper layer' composes the registry's practice (each capture sealed under an AXN, read, and answered by later work) as the archive's mandate, from the Semantic Addresses card.
NO PERSON. Lee Sharks is named nowhere in the answer; Rex Fraction, #1724's co-author, is not named.
analysis: A table of real records with one identifier mispaired, and a window that ends two days before the date asked, at the top of the index the Overview read. The archive is composed as a combatant ('counter-offensive', 'ontological war', 'immune system') in phrases its records do not carry; no person stands behind it.
